subject.title: feat(agents): add iteration budget for agent loop safety

question: Should `iterationBudget` ship as a generic per-agent contract that fails closed on unsupported harnesses, or must every bundled tool-executing harness support it before release?
rationale: Code inspection can validate the OpenClaw/Codex implementation, but it cannot choose the permanent public config names/defaults, forced-summary policy, or plugin-harness compatibility contract.

options.title: Require bundled-harness coverage
options.body: Implement equivalent enforcement for every bundled tool-executing harness before shipping the generic configuration.

options.title: Ship explicit partial support
options.body: Keep fail-closed behavior, but document and validate the supported harness set before starting a run.

options.title: Pause for a generic seam
options.body: Hold the feature until a harness-neutral iteration-budget contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Require bundled-harness coverage
recommendation.body: Implement equivalent enforcement for every bundled tool-executing harness before shipping the generic configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: She is the live assignee and authored the maintainer follow-up that established the current cross-harness behavior.
